about: Ground truth for the magic-link test. Every coordinate is the parcel point from Norfolk's address dataset, looked up 2026-10-20 with socrata-agent's lookup_address tool. Landmark names were checked the same day: Chrysler Museum of Art (1 Memorial Place), Slover Library (235 E Plume St), Virginia Zoo (3500 Granby St). Addresses are public buildings or plain street addresses; no case names or implicates a person.

cases.say: The storm drain in front of the Chrysler Museum floods every time it rains.
A streetlight has been out on the 800 block of Union Street for a week.
There's a huge pothole on Granby Street right outside the Virginia Zoo.
Tree roots have heaved up the sidewalk next to Slover Library downtown.
A big limb came down and is blocking the sidewalk at 245 Granby St.
Water pools across the road in front of 610 May Ave after every storm.
Trash keeps piling up along the curb at 7300 Newport Ave.
The stop sign at 113 Waterside Drive is bent over and hard to see.
My neighbor two doors down keeps junk cars on his lawn. Report him.
